property_summary: After calling allowance(this, 0) with msg.sender having wards value 0, the reference reverts due to auth check failing, but the buggy contract succeeds, causing wards[this] to be set to 1 via the delegatecall to share's approve.
change_summary: Replace 'require(wards[msg.sender] == 1, "Auth/not-authorized");' with 'require(wards[msg.sender] == 0, "Auth/not-authorized");' to invert the authorization condition.
